HeroSection.title: An-Nusra Foundation
HeroSection.subtitle: It is a non-political, non-profit, religious, social and humanitarian organization.

ServiceSection.title: An-Nusra's Services
ServiceSection.subtitle: Let everyone have a happy life
ServiceSection.description: Our activities, social development, and humanitarian works are in accordance with Quran-Sunnah.

services.title: Education
services.description: Establishing curriculum and textbooks, setting up educational institutions, and managing them by integrating modern education with Quran-Sunnah.

services.title: Service
services.description: Organizing activities to distribute winter clothes, iftar during Ramadan, clothes and Eid materials to the needy, and distributing sacrificial animals to the poor.
projects: Healthcare for Distressed Women and Children

services.title: Da'wah
services.description: Managing family counseling department and religious inquiry call center to maintain a religious environment at the family level.

services.title: Islamic Economics
services.description: Providing financial assistance for self-reliance through training in handicrafts, machine industry, technical skills, agriculture, and farm management to eliminate unemployment and poverty.

services.title: Islamic Culture
services.description: Building Islamic cultural centers and organizing various cultural competitions like Islamic music, poetry recitation, calligraphy for the entertainment and moral awakening of children and adolescents.

ServiceSection.ctaTitle: Want to be a partner in establishing a Quran-Sunnah based society?
ServiceSection.ctaDescription: Your sincere participation will help play a role in the journey of establishing society and humanitarian work in the light of Quran-Sunnah.
